key.name: active-portfolio
key.description: The currently selected portfolio identifier.

key.name: portfolios
key.description: JSON encoded storage for user portfolios, symbols, and local holdings.

key.name: providers-enabled
key.description: Ordered list of enabled provider IDs for quote fetching and failover.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Location of the extension indicator on the GNOME Shell top panel.

key.name: ticker-cycling-enabled
key.description: Whether the top panel ticker automatically cycles through portfolio symbols.

key.name: ticker-interval
key.description: Interval in seconds between ticker symbol rotations.

key.name: ticker-mode
key.description: Format of the price text rendered in the top panel ticker.

key.name: ticker-pause-on-hover
key.description: Temporarily pause ticker symbol rotation when mouse hovers over the indicator.

key.name: pinned-symbol
key.description: If set, pins the top panel ticker to display only this symbol.

key.name: display-currency
key.description: Target currency ISO code for quotes and conversion.

key.name: hide-private-values
key.description: Privacy toggle to mask exact portfolio amounts and P&L values in UI.

key.name: market-polling-interval
key.description: Data update polling frequency in seconds during active market hours.

key.name: off-market-polling-interval
key.description: Data update polling frequency in seconds outside market hours.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Reduce polling frequency when host device is running on battery power.

key.name: alerts-enabled
key.description: Master switch for session-bound price alert notifications.

key.name: alert-rules
key.description: JSON encoded storage for user configured price alert thresholds.

key.name: quiet-hours-enabled
key.description: Suppress alert notifications during specified hours.

key.name: quiet-hours-start
key.description: Start time for quiet hours in HH:MM format.

key.name: quiet-hours-end
key.description: End time for quiet hours in HH:MM format.

key.name: colorblind-mode
key.description: Use blue/orange color palette instead of green/red for price changes.

key.name: quick-settings-integration
key.description: Add a pause/resume polling toggle to GNOME Shell Quick Settings menu.

key.name: menu-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Market Pulse panel menu.

key.name: menu-shortcut-enabled
key.description: Whether the configurable keyboard shortcut for opening the menu is active.

key.name: search-provider-enabled
key.description: Show tracked symbol quotes as results in the GNOME Shell overview search.

key.name: first-run-complete
key.description: Set once the onboarding dialog offering a demo portfolio has been shown.

key.name: comparison-symbols
key.description: Additional symbols overlaid on the detail chart as normalized percentage series.

key.name: symbol-display-overrides
key.description: JSON map of symbol to ticker display format, overriding the global ticker mode.

key.name: recent-searches
key.description: Most recent symbol search queries, offered as shortcuts in the add-symbol dialog.

key.name: schema-version
key.description: Internal version marker used by the settings migration framework.
